g.text: SOPilot QA request lifecycle, as built (ai-service, 2026-11-16)
POST /ai/v1/conversations/{id}/messages -> QAService.answer -> run_steps; first non-continue Decision ends the chain
Decision layer: deterministic, no LLM (qa/steps.py, qa/router.py)
- rewrite runs on every turn with history
- follow-up signal used only on rewrite fail
